text: Jordan Grimmer-Tufik please forgive the use of a nickname, I wish to continue to preserve my anonymity. I mixed up some of the facts. The appeal window was 21 days and the appeal was submitted in time. The office actually included a note in the decision saying that if the deposit isn’t paid up within 45 days, the file would be closed. Today is the 45th calendar day. Or the file would not be automatically closed if our appeal is submitted in time?  We don’t have a decision on the appeal due to the office closures and we are not sure what will happen to our file.
